editorial.text: Some impressive campaigning from children’s laureates, past and present, for school libraries plus the Read On Get On coalition notes the impact of their reduction on reading. It’s good to see school libraries being highlighted. Because of their less public nature, cuts to school libraries often don’t get the publicity that anything similar in public libraries would receive. But the impact of the loss of a school library when it comes to a child’s literacy is incalculable. Moreover, there is a natural partnership between school and public libraries. Here’s wishing them the best.
